description: This file defines a Python module for language code enumerations used in speech and text processing within the Pipecat project. It includes a comprehensive 'Language' enum with ISO 639 and BCP 47 language codes, and a utility function 'resolve_language' for converting enum values to service-specific language codes, with fallback and logging.

classes.name: StrEnum
classes.description: A string enumeration base class for Python versions earlier than 3.11, providing compatibility for enum string values.

methods.name: resolve_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to a service-specific language code, using a provided mapping and fallback with warnings if the language is not verified.
